fields.name: human_typed
fields.label: Typed words
fields.description: Typed words are text you typed or dictated; pastes, copied agent output, templates, attachments, app instructions and automated prompts are counted separately.

fields.name: human_words
fields.label: User words
fields.description: All user words count every word of each classified user message, whatever its source; Text source splits them.

fields.name: human_typed_messages
fields.label: Messages with typed text
fields.description: Messages holding at least one typed or dictated word.

fields.name: human_messages
fields.label: User messages
fields.description: Every classified user message, including those holding only supplied text.

fields.name: human_conversations
fields.label: Conversations
fields.description: Distinct conversations with a matching message. A conversation in several groups counts once in each, so groups do not add up to the total.

fields.name: human_typed_share
fields.label: Typed share of words
fields.description: Typed words divided by all user words, pooled over each group's messages rather than averaging per-message shares.

fields.name: human_words_per_message
fields.label: Typed words per typed message
fields.description: Typed words divided by messages holding any, pooled; messages without typed text do not dilute it.

fields.name: human_copied_share
fields.label: Messages with copied text (%)
fields.description: Messages holding text matched to an earlier conversation, divided by all messages, pooled.

fields.name: tokens_tokens
fields.label: Tokens
fields.description: Tokens include cached input and reported reasoning output.

fields.name: tokens_cost
fields.label: API cost (USD)
fields.description: API cost is the list-price equivalent, including assumed and partial prices; unpriced usage has no cost and adds nothing.

fields.name: tokens_priced_cost
fields.label: Fully priced API cost (USD)
fields.description: Only fully priced usage (price_status=priced) is included; assumed, partial and unpriced usage is left out of every measure in this view.

fields.name: tokens_input
fields.label: Input tokens
fields.description: Input includes cache reads and cache writes.

fields.name: tokens_output
fields.label: Output tokens
fields.description: Output includes reported reasoning output.

fields.name: tokens_cache_read_share
fields.label: Cache read share (%)
fields.description: Cache reads divided by all input, cache writes included, weighted by tokens rather than averaging per-record percentages.

fields.name: tokens_output_share
fields.label: Output token share (%)
fields.description: Output tokens divided by all recorded tokens, weighted by tokens.

fields.name: tokens_delegating_share
fields.label: Conversations using delegation
fields.description: Top-level conversations with an active delegated execution divided by all top-level conversations with matching usage. Over time computes each period separately; smoothing averages those period shares.

fields.name: tokens_delegated_share
fields.label: Delegated share of tokens
fields.description: Tokens from delegated runs divided by all matching tokens, grouped by their top-level conversation when a conversation unit is chosen.

fields.name: tokens_root_conversations
fields.label: Top-level conversations with usage
fields.description: Distinct top-level conversations with matching usage, delegated runs folded into their roots.

fields.name: tokens_conversations
fields.label: Conversations with usage
fields.description: Distinct conversations with usage. A conversation using several groups counts once in each, so groups do not add up to the total.

fields.name: tokens_agent_sessions
fields.label: Agent sessions
fields.description: Distinct agent sessions with usage. A session using several groups counts once in each.

fields.name: tokens_delegated_runs
fields.label: Delegated runs
fields.description: Distinct delegated executions with usage; the top-level run is not one. Handles and child transcripts count once.

fields.name: tokens_average_fanout
fields.label: Average direct child runs per delegating agent
fields.description: Distinct direct child executions divided by their distinct recorded parents, including initiating agents and nested parents. Each parent has equal weight; only parents with matching positive-token child usage count. Repeated days and linked transcripts count once within each period. Periods with no delegation have no value. Smoothing, when selected, averages period means; it does not recalculate distinct counts across periods.

fields.name: activity_conversations
fields.label: Active conversations
fields.description: Distinct top-level conversations with a human message or recorded output in the range, including their delegated activity. A conversation in several groups counts once in each, so groups do not add up to the total.

fields.name: activity_messages
fields.label: Human messages
fields.description: Classified user messages holding any text besides app instructions and automated prompts.

fields.name: activity_output
fields.label: Conversation output tokens
fields.description: Recorded model output attributed to each conversation.

fields.name: calls_time
fields.label: Recorded tool time
fields.description: Recorded durations can overlap and may include approval waits. Their sum is tool time, not elapsed wall time.

fields.name: calls_calls
fields.label: Tool calls
fields.description: Every recorded call counts once, including errors and calls without a duration.

fields.name: calls_mean_time
fields.label: Mean tool call duration
fields.description: Recorded duration divided by calls with a duration, pooled over each group's calls; calls without timing are left out.

fields.name: calls_failures
fields.label: Failed calls
fields.description: Calls recorded as errors. A shell command’s non-zero exit can be expected, such as a search with no matches.

fields.name: calls_failure_rate
fields.label: Tool failure rate (%)
fields.description: Failed calls divided by all matching calls, pooled over each group.

fields.name: calls_truncation_rate
fields.label: Tool truncation rate (%)
fields.description: Calls with truncated results divided by all matching calls.

fields.name: calls_conversations
fields.label: Conversations reached
fields.description: Distinct agent conversations with matching calls; a conversation can appear in several groups.

fields.name: calls_repositories
fields.label: Repositories reached
fields.description: Distinct repositories with matching calls; a repository can appear in several groups.

fields.name: calls_carried_tokens
fields.label: Context carried
fields.description: Attributed tool-result tokens carried into later requests.

fields.name: calls_result_tokens
fields.label: Result tokens
fields.description: Tokens a call's result added to the context, measured or estimated from retained result text.

fields.name: skills_records
fields.label: Skill evidence records
fields.description: Observed invocations, file loads and app-reported loads. A load does not prove a skill was followed.

fields.name: skills_body
fields.label: Saved instruction size
fields.description: Body volume sums known positive recorded sizes, including repeated loads; evidence without a recorded size is left out.

fields.name: skills_conversations
fields.label: Conversations reached
fields.description: Distinct conversations with skill evidence. A conversation with several skills counts once in each, so groups do not add up to the total.

fields.name: skills_repositories
fields.label: Repositories reached
fields.description: Distinct repositories holding matching skill evidence; a repository can appear under several skills.

fields.name: skills_loads
fields.label: Distinct file-load calls
fields.description: Distinct tool calls that loaded a skill file; duplicate evidence for one call counts once.

fields.name: compaction_compactions
fields.label: Compactions
fields.description: Counts boundary events, including consecutive compactions and boundaries without later usage. Human means manual; machine means automatic. Claude records the trigger; Codex infers it from turn position. Unknown triggers remain separate.

fields.name: compaction_conversations
fields.label: Conversations with compactions
fields.description: Distinct recorded conversations with a compaction. A conversation may appear under several triggers, so groups do not add up to the total.

fields.name: session_shape_sessions
fields.label: Agent sessions
fields.description: Agent sessions: each conversation once, a delegated run as its own session. Mirrors and aliases of one session count once.

fields.name: session_shape_active_hours
fields.label: Active hours
fields.description: Time between consecutive messages, counting gaps of 300 seconds or less; a longer gap counts as zero.

fields.name: session_shape_active_time
fields.label: Active time per session
fields.description: Active time divided by sessions with timestamps, pooled. Per session it is the value the distribution draws.

fields.name: session_shape_messages
fields.label: Messages
fields.description: Every message of the session's own stream; an embedded sub-agent's messages are its own.

fields.name: session_shape_typed_messages
fields.label: Typed human messages
fields.description: User messages holding text you typed or dictated. Pasted, quoted, re-sent, template, harness and automated text does not count. Only sessions whose prompts are all classified.

fields.name: session_shape_tool_calls
fields.label: Tool calls
fields.description: The session's own tool calls, in sessions the tool ledger covers.

fields.name: session_shape_autonomy
fields.label: Tool calls per typed message
fields.description: Tool calls per message holding text you typed (a session with none counts one), pooled: summed calls over summed messages. Pasted or quoted text alone does not count as a message.

fields.name: session_shape_calls_per_words
fields.label: Tool calls per 100 typed words
fields.description: Tool calls per 100 words you typed, pooled: summed calls over summed typed words. Only sessions where you typed something; pasted and quoted text is not typed.

fields.name: session_shape_turn_cycle
fields.label: Mean session median turn cycle
fields.description: Each session's median gap from a typed human message to the agent's next message, leaving out gaps over 1,800 seconds. Pooled over groups it is the mean of those medians; the distribution draws them.

fields.name: session_shape_active_share
fields.label: Active share of wall time
fields.description: Active time divided by first-to-last message time, pooled over sessions.

fields.name: session_shape_context_peak
fields.label: Peak context share
fields.description: Each session's largest request input divided by its model's context window, the figure the reader's context rail uses; only sessions whose window is known. Pooled over groups it is the mean of the sessions' peaks.

fields.name: session_shape_one_shot_rate
fields.label: One-shot edit turns
fields.description: Human turns with an edit and no edit–verify–edit retry on one file, divided by turns with an edit, pooled.

fields.name: session_shape_steering_load
fields.label: Steering load
fields.description: Typed messages with a correction cue in the typed text, divided by typed messages, pooled. Pasted text is never a correction.

fields.name: session_shape_verification
fields.label: Verified handbacks
fields.description: Handbacks after an edit in which a test or build command ran after the last edit, divided by handbacks after an edit, pooled.

fields.name: session_shape_failure_rate
fields.label: Failure rate
fields.description: Failed calls divided by tool calls, pooled. Rejections, interrupts and hook blocks are not failures.

fields.name: session_shape_failed_calls
fields.label: Failed calls
fields.description: Calls that failed, other than your rejections, interrupts and hook blocks.

fields.name: session_shape_rejections
fields.label: Rejections
fields.description: Calls you rejected.

fields.name: session_shape_interrupts
fields.label: Interrupts
fields.description: Calls interrupted before they finished.

fields.name: session_shape_hook_blocks
fields.label: Hook blocks
fields.description: Calls a hook blocked.

fields.name: session_shape_identical_retries
fields.label: Identical retries
fields.description: Runs of three or more consecutive calls with the same tool and byte-identical input; each run adds its length less one.

fields.name: session_shape_thrash_retries
fields.label: Edit–verify–edit retries
fields.description: Within one human turn, an edit to a file, then a test or build command, then another edit to that file. Read-only commands are not verification.

fields.name: session_shape_churned_files
fields.label: Churned files
fields.description: Files edited three or more times within fewer than 10 messages.

fields.name: session_shape_mid_task_compactions
fields.label: Mid-task compactions
fields.description: Compactions with at least two tool names both among the 10 calls before and the 5 after.

fields.name: session_shape_context_pressure
fields.label: Sessions over 90% of context
fields.description: Sessions whose peak context exceeded 90% of the model's window; only sessions whose window is known.

fields.name: session_shape_corrections
fields.label: Corrections
fields.description: Typed messages with a correction cue in the typed text.

fields.name: session_shape_long_unprompted_runs
fields.label: Long unprompted runs
fields.description: Runs of more than 150 tool calls with no typed human message between them.

fields.name: session_shape_ended_on_failure
fields.label: Ended on a failed call
fields.description: Experimental: the session's last tool call failed and nothing you typed follows. It does not say the work was abandoned.

fields.name: session_shape_forensic_events
fields.label: Forensic events
fields.description: Every signal's count added up: a way to find sessions to read, not a score.

fields.name: agent_experience_events
fields.label: Agent events
fields.description: Sentences the model judged to express a kind of event, at or above its confidence threshold. A sentence can count under more than one kind.

fields.name: agent_experience_conversations
fields.label: Conversations with events
fields.description: Distinct agent conversations with a matching event; a conversation can appear in several groups.

fields.name: agent_experience_messages
fields.label: Messages with events
fields.description: Distinct agent messages (visible replies or thinking blocks) with a matching event.

fields.name: agent_experience_repositories
fields.label: Repositories with events
fields.description: Distinct repositories with a matching event.

fields.name: agent_experience_thinking_share
fields.label: Share in thinking
fields.description: Events found in agents' private reasoning, divided by all matching events. Visible replies are the rest.

fields.name: agent_experience_explained_share
fields.label: Share with a stated cause
fields.description: Events whose cause the model found in a sentence other than the event's own, divided by all matching events.

fields.name: agent_event_rates_per_thousand
fields.label: Events per 1,000 messages read
fields.description: Matching events divided by the agent messages the events pass read (replies and thinking blocks), per 1,000. A message can hold several events.

fields.name: agent_event_rates_message_share
fields.label: Share of messages read with an event
fields.description: Agent messages with at least one matching event, divided by the agent messages the pass read.

fields.name: agent_event_rates_turn_share
fields.label: Share of turns with an event
fields.description: Turns with at least one matching event in a message read, divided by the turns with a message read. A turn is a prompt and what followed it; a turn counts in every group it has messages in.

fields.name: agent_event_rates_conversation_share
fields.label: Share of conversations with an event
fields.description: Conversations with at least one matching event, divided by the conversations with a message read. A conversation counts in every group it has messages in; a delegated subagent is a conversation of its own.

fields.name: agent_event_rates_events
fields.label: Events
fields.description: Sentences the model judged to express a kind of event, at or above its confidence threshold. Counts follow how much agents worked; the rates divide by what the pass read.

fields.name: agent_event_rates_messages
fields.label: Messages read
fields.description: Agent messages the events pass read: the denominator of the per-message rates. A kind filter does not change it.

fields.name: labels_messages
fields.label: Messages
fields.description: Distinct matching messages. A message can carry several labels. Shares divide by all distinct messages in each interval; labels can overlap.

fields.name: labels_conversations
fields.label: Conversations
fields.description: Distinct retained conversations with a matching label.

fields.name: labels_labels
fields.label: Distinct message labels
fields.description: Different accepted specific labels, including explicit coverage states.

fields.name: labels_observations
fields.label: Label matches
fields.description: One observation per most-specific accepted label, or one coverage observation when no label is accepted. Messages with several labels contribute several matches.

fields.name: carbon_co2
fields.label: Estimated CO₂e (g)
fields.description: Estimated with your Carbon Impact assumptions (estimate range, facility overhead, grid and input sensitivity); token counts are reported, energy and CO₂e are modeled. Models are assigned to size tiers by name; unmatched models use the default tier.

fields.name: carbon_energy
fields.label: Estimated electricity (Wh)
fields.description: Facility electricity: IT energy times facility overhead (PUE). Estimated with your Carbon Impact assumptions (estimate range, facility overhead, grid and input sensitivity); token counts are reported, energy and CO₂e are modeled. Models are assigned to size tiers by name; unmatched models use the default tier.

fields.name: work_hours_wall_hours
fields.label: Agent wall hours
fields.description: Wall hours are clock time: each record holds its share of the hour, one over the agents (or, for you, conversations) active at once, so groups add up without counting an hour twice. Your time and your agents' overlap: add them only within one.

fields.name: work_hours_active_hours
fields.label: Active agent hours
fields.description: Active hours count each agent's own time, so two agents working through one hour are two hours.

fields.name: work_hours_parallel_hours
fields.label: Hours with parallel agents
fields.description: Wall time with two or more agents active at once, shared among them as wall hours are.

fields.name: work_hours_messages
fields.label: Typed messages during activity hours
fields.description: Messages with text you typed, counted in the hour you sent them.

fields.name: work_hours_typed_words
fields.label: Typed words during activity hours
fields.description: Words you typed, from Human Words' classification.

fields.name: work_hours_turns
fields.label: Agent turns started
fields.description: Agent turns, each counted in the hour its prompt was sent.

fields.name: work_hours_at_once
fields.label: Agents at once during work hours
fields.description: Active time over wall time, pooled: the time-weighted number of agents working together while any is. For you it is always one.

fields.name: work_hours_conversations
fields.label: Conversations with activity hours
fields.description: Distinct top-level conversations active in each group. One active in several groups counts in each.

fields.name: parallelism_agent_hours
fields.label: Workspace hours
fields.description: Workspace hours count each active workspace's time, so two workspaces working through one hour are two workspace hours.

fields.name: parallelism_active_hours
fields.label: Active hours
fields.description: Active hours are wall time with any workspace active. Each record holds its share of that time (one over the workspaces active at once), so groups add up to the wall time without counting an hour twice.

fields.name: parallelism_parallel_hours
fields.label: Hours with two or more at once
fields.description: Wall time with two or more workspaces active at once, shared among them as active hours are.

fields.name: parallelism_at_once
fields.label: Workspaces at once while active
fields.description: Agent time divided by wall time with any workspace active, pooled over each group's records: the time-weighted number of workspaces working together while any is.

fields.name: parallelism_agents
fields.label: Active conversations
fields.description: Distinct workspaces active in each group. One active in several groups counts in each.

fields.name: work_hours_engaged_hours
fields.label: Your engaged hours
fields.description: Estimated engaged human time, shared among top-level conversations active at once. Human and agent hours can overlap and are measured separately.

fields.name: writing_messages_chars
fields.label: User message characters
fields.description: Characters in classified user messages; other message roles and unclassified text have no measurement.

fields.name: writing_messages_pasted_words
fields.label: Pasted words
fields.description: Words classified as likely pasted text.

fields.name: writing_messages_copied_words
fields.label: Copied or re-sent words
fields.description: Words matched to previous agent output or earlier user text.

fields.name: writing_messages_prompt_words
fields.label: Template and attachment words
fields.description: Words in templates and attachment references.

fields.name: writing_messages_machine_words
fields.label: App and automation words
fields.description: Words supplied by the app or automation.

fields.name: usage_uncached_input_tokens
fields.label: Uncached input tokens
fields.description: Input tokens excluding cache reads and writes.

fields.name: usage_cache_read_input_tokens
fields.label: Cache read tokens
fields.description: Recorded cache reads.

fields.name: usage_cache_creation_input_tokens
fields.label: Cache write tokens
fields.description: Recorded cache writes.

fields.name: usage_reasoning_output_tokens
fields.label: Reasoning tokens
fields.description: Reasoning output reported by the source; unavailable measurements remain missing.

fields.name: model_requests_gap_seconds
fields.label: Response wait
fields.description: Mean recorded wait after tool results, in seconds; requests without timing are excluded.

fields.name: model_requests_input_tokens
fields.label: Mean request input
fields.description: Mean input tokens per recorded model request.

fields.name: model_requests_output_tokens
fields.label: Mean request output
fields.description: Mean output tokens per recorded model request.

fields.name: tool_calls_lines_added
fields.label: Lines added
fields.description: Recorded lines added by tool calls.

fields.name: tool_calls_lines_removed
fields.label: Lines removed
fields.description: Recorded lines removed by tool calls.

fields.name: tool_calls_result_bytes
fields.label: Tool result bytes
fields.description: Recorded result size in bytes.

fields.name: tool_calls_input_bytes
fields.label: Tool input bytes
fields.description: Recorded tool input size in bytes.

fields.name: session_shape_wall_seconds
fields.label: Wall time
fields.description: Last message time minus first.

fields.name: session_shape_idle_seconds
fields.label: Idle time
fields.description: Wall time minus active time.

fields.name: session_shape_files_edited
fields.label: Files edited
fields.description: Distinct files touched by edit-family tools that did not fail.

fields.name: session_shape_subagents
fields.label: Delegated agents
fields.description: Delegated runs the session launched: embedded and linked sub-agent sessions, and headless agent runs its shell commands started.

fields.name: session_shape_turn_cycles
fields.label: Turn cycles
fields.description: Typed human messages answered by an assistant message within 1,800 seconds.

fields.name: session_shape_first_response_seconds
fields.label: First response wait
fields.description: The same gap for the first typed human message only.

fields.name: session_shape_turn_cycle_p90_seconds
fields.label: Turn cycle p90
fields.description: 90th percentile of the same gaps.

fields.name: session_shape_max_unprompted_tool_calls
fields.label: Longest unprompted tool run
fields.description: The longest run of tool calls with no typed human message between them.

fields.name: session_shape_failure_streak_max
fields.label: Longest failure streak
fields.description: Longest run of consecutive failed calls. Empty without enough evidence.

fields.name: session_shape_context_peak_tokens
fields.label: Peak context tokens
fields.description: Largest request input, cached input included, in the session's own stream. Empty without enough evidence.

fields.name: session_shape_verified_handbacks
fields.label: Verified handbacks
fields.description: Handbacks after an edit where a test, build or lint command ran after the last edit. Empty without enough evidence.

fields.name: session_shape_unverified_handbacks
fields.label: Unverified handbacks
fields.description: Edit handbacks without a verification after the last edit. Empty without enough evidence.
